get.summary: Lists the collections of a website, by name.

parameters.name: websiteId
parameters.description: The website whose collections are listed.

200.description: The website's collections with their fields.

post.summary: Creates a collection and the detail page its items are shown with.
post.description: The detail page starts empty; design it in the studio like any page.

201.description: Created; the body is the collection.

400.description: The request is invalid, or another collection uses the slug.

404.description: No website exists with this id.

get.summary: Gets a collection with its fields.

404.description: No collection exists with this id.

put.summary: Changes a collection's names, slug and fields.
put.description:
Items keep their values for fields that stay. Values of removed fields are dropped the next time an item is saved.
Pages that show a removed field report it when they are next published.

200.description: Saved; the body is the collection.

400.description: The request is invalid, or another collection uses the slug.

404.description: No collection exists with this id.

delete.summary: Deletes a collection, its items and its detail page.

404.description: No collection exists with this id.

get.summary: Lists a collection's items, newest first.

404.description: No collection exists with this id.

post.summary: Adds an item to a collection.
post.description: Values are checked against the collection's fields: types, required fields, links, images and rich text.

201.description: Created; the body is the item.

400.description: The request is invalid; errors are keyed `slug` or `values.{fieldId}`.

404.description: No collection exists with this id.

get.summary: Gets one item of a collection.

404.description: The collection has no item with this id.

put.summary: Saves an item: its slug, values and status. Publishing is saving with status `published`.

200.description: Saved; the body is the item.

400.description: The request is invalid; errors are keyed `slug` or `values.{fieldId}`.

404.description: The collection has no item with this id.
The collection has no item with this id.

get.summary: Lists the media items of a website, newest first.

parameters.name: websiteId
parameters.description: The website whose media library is listed.

200.description: The website's media items, newest first.

post.summary: Uploads an image to a website's media library and creates its thumbnail.
post.description:
Accepts JPEG, PNG, GIF and WebP files up to 10 MB and 100 megapixels. The file's contents are checked
as well as its extension, so a file that is not really a supported image, or is damaged, is rejected.

201.description: The image was stored; the body is the new media item.

400.description: The file is missing, empty, too large, damaged, or not a supported image.

404.description: No website exists with the given id.

get.summary: Gets a single media item's details.

404.description: No media item exists with this id.

delete.summary: Deletes a media item together with its original image and thumbnail.

204.description: The media item and its files were deleted.

404.description: No media item exists with this id.

get.summary: Streams the original image as it was uploaded.
get.description: The response may be cached indefinitely, because a media item's files never change.

404.description: No media item or stored image exists with this id.

200.description: The original image (JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP).

get.description: The response may be cached indefinitely, because a media item's files never change.

404.description: No media item or stored thumbnail exists with this id.

204.description: The page exists but has no content yet.

404.description: No page exists with this id.

put.summary: Publishes a page: stores the document and marks the content published. The studio calls this on Publish.
put.description:
The document must pass the structural rules (block types, ranges, safe links, allowed rich text) and the content
rules (no missing images, links that go somewhere). Errors are answered with a validation problem whose
`issues` point at the sections and blocks to fix; warnings don't block and come back with the result.

200.description: Published; the body is the content and any warnings.

400.description: The document is malformed or has errors to fix first.

404.description: No page exists with this id.

413.description: The request body is larger than 1 MB.

get.summary: Lists the pages of a website, most recently updated first.

parameters.name: websiteId
parameters.description: The website whose pages are listed.

200.description: The website's pages, most recently updated first.

get.summary: Lists all websites, most recently updated first.

200.description: All websites, most recently updated first.
